notes.title: High-Difficulty Stages & Assist Mode Added! On Sale Now at 20% OFF!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone, 

Thank you for your continued support for Telebbit. Telebbit has been updated to v1.04! This version includes the following features and fixes:[/h3]

[h2][b]Addition of high difficulty stages for each zone, called "Area C"[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] The new Area C stages can be played in Overheat Mode. Area C stages exist in each zone and are challenging stages created from the most difficult maps.
[*] With this update, you can now generate save data for Overheat Mode without beating the game. Overheat Mode can be accessed for any areas that you have cleared in Normal Mode.
[/list]

[h2][b]Assist Mode[/b][/h2]
If you find the game too difficult while playing in Normal Mode, you can turn on "Assist Mode" in the game's settings. Playing the game in "Assist Mode" will have the following effects:
[list]
[*] The player will only take damage from falling into lava-like hazards. 
[*] When playing with "Assist Mode" on, you will not be able to collect "carrots," the collectible items in the game.
[/list]

[h2][b]Fixes & Additions[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] If multiple controllers are connected simultaneously, all of them will be detected by the game.
[*] A suicide button has been added. This allows the player to escape from any unwanted predicament. By default, it is the Backspace key on keyboard or the right analog stick button on controllers. 
[*] A setting to turn "Blood Effects" ON or OFF has been added to the settings menu. The default value is OFF, and when it is ON, all previous blood splats from death are shown in their full color, rather than their default grey.
[*] Some maps have been updated to accommodate play in Assist Mode.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support. If you experience any bugs, please report them in this thread: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2504250/discussions/0/4701287772393179493/]Telebbit Bug Reporting[/url]
